core_features_to_implement: 1. Login authentication (Admin: admin / admin123, Kasir: kasir / kasir123) with role switching and token/session handling.
2. Dashboard with interactive charts (Omset Hari Ini, Jumlah Transaksi, Total Produk, Peringatan Stok Menipis & Habis, Grafik Penjualan 7 Hari Terakhir, Transaksi Terkini).
3. POS Kasir screen: Barcode input autofocus, real-time live search, Sembako category chips (Beras, Minyak, Telur, Gula, Bumbu, Sabun/Deterjen, Minuman, Rokok/Snack), interactive product card grid.
4. Real-time POS Cart: Qty increment/decrement, direct qty input, custom item discount (nominal/percent), transaction discount, delete item, clear cart.
5. Hold & Resume Transaction (Tahan Transaksi): Support parking multiple pending customer carts with custom label/timestamp and resuming with 1-click.

6. Payment Modal (Multi-metode): Tunai with quick cash buttons (Pas, Rp10.000, Rp20.000, Rp50.000, Rp100.000, Rp200.000), QRIS with generated simulated QR preview, Transfer Bank, Debit/Kredit, E-Wallet (GoPay, OVO, Dana, ShopeePay), dynamic kembalian calculation.
7. Thermal Receipt Modal + Browser Native Print: Switchable 58mm & 80mm preview with realistic dot-matrix receipt styling and direct window.print() support.

8. Product Management (CRUD): SKU, barcode, nama produk, kategori, satuan (kg, pcs, liter, renteng, dus, pack), harga beli, harga jual, stok, minimal stok, status aktif. Auto-generate barcode CODE128.
9. Barcode Label Print Dialog: Select products, quantity of labels to print, label size, and print preview.
10. Categories Management (CRUD): Icon picker, category color, product counter.
11. Sales History & Reports: Filter by date range, payment method, cashier; detail breakdown with itemized modal and 'Cetak Struk Ulang' (reprint receipt).
12. User Management: Add/edit cashier and admin users with PIN/password and active status.
13. Global Keyboard Shortcuts (F1-F9, Enter, Esc) with floating shortcut guide cheat sheet modal.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_spirit: Clean modern Indonesian warung POS: crisp emerald green (#15803D), deep forest header, warm golden accents, clean white cards, high-contrast readable typography for fast cashier checkout. No AI slop or generic gray cards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_requirement: Every actionable button, input, tab, modal trigger, and badge MUST have a meaningful data-testid (e.g. data-testid='pos-barcode-input', data-testid='pos-checkout-btn', data-testid='quick-cash-pas-btn', data-testid='print-thermal-receipt-btn').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.currency_formatting: All monetary values must be formatted in Indonesian Rupiah standard (e.g., 'Rp 75.000' using Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID', { style: 'currency', currency: 'IDR', minimumFractionDigits: 0 })).
